text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - Two South Korean flour mills, Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd and Cheiljedang Corp bought a combined total of 23,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat on Wednesday from a Japanese trading house, Itochu Corp. Shipment was set for November 25-December 25 from the Pacific Northwest to the southeastern ports of Pusan and Ulsan. Prices paid by Dongah ranged from $190.70 to $206.41 per tonne (FOB) while Cheiljedang paid $0.55 to $0.96 per bushel premium to December Chicago Board of Trade futures.

WHEAT SALES (cont.) - Jordan bought 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat, split equally between first half and last half Oct shipment. The purchase included 10,000 tonnes of soft wheat priced around $200 per tonne and 90,000 tonnes of hard wheat at $206, cost and freight.

- Taiwan's Provincial Food Bureau bought on Wednesday a 15,470-tonne shipment of U.S. No. 1 wheat for the armed forces, including 7,770 tonnes of soft wheat and 7,700 tonnes of hard red winter, October 1-20 shipment. Prices ranged from $193.75 to $204.75 a tonne.

WHEAT SALES (cont.) - The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA said it bought 29,027 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat from United Grain Corp for donation to Bangladesh, September 10-October 5 shipment. The wheat was priced at $190.82 to $191.69 a tonne, FOB.
WHEAT TENDERS - Moldova cancelled a buying tender for 35,000 tonnes of PL-480 HRW wheat for shipment September 5 and 25, agents for the buyer said.
- The CCC tendered Wednesday for 17,000 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS) wheat for donation to Nicaragua. Shipment is for Nov 15-Dec 10.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association is to tender Thursday for 98,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 or No.2 wheat, traders said. All shipments are from the Pacific Northwest. For Sept 10-30 it seeks 16,300 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS), 7,000 hard red winter (HRW), and 2,700 white wheat; for Sept 20-Oct 10 19,500 of DNS, 10,000 HRW and 4,500 white; for Sept 25-Oct 20 23,500 DNS, 9,600 HRW and 4,900 white wheat.
- The CCC tendered Wednesday for 16,000 tonnes of HRW, SRW or soft white wheat for donation to Tajikistan. Shipment is for Sept 15-Oct 10.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - Sri Lanka will tender on August 30 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S., Canadian or Argentinian wheat. It seeks 50,000 tonnes of soft wheat for September shipment and 50,000 tonnes of hard wheat for October shipment.

SOYBEAN TENDER - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association plans to tender on Thusday for two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. soybeans. One 54,000 tonne shipment was slated for Nov 11-25 shipment, if U.S. Gulf, or Nov 26-Dec 10 if Pacific Northwest. The second was for Dec 6-20 if U.S. Gulf or Dec 21-Jan 4 if PNW.
SOYBEAN TENDERS (cont.) - News was awaited on Pakistan's tender Wednesday for 30,000 to 34,000 tonnes of PL-480 No 2 yellow soybeans. Delivery is for Oct 15-30.

MARKET TALK - Saudi Arabia may reduce a major purchase of barley from the world market by 25 percent to 600,000 tonnes, European grain traders and officials said...A North Korean ship will berth at Bangkok port to lift about 10,000 tonnes of Thai rice in early September...Morocco is forecasting soft wheat imports at around 1.0 million tonnes for the 1996/97 season, down from 2.5 million in 1995/96 following a record cereal harvest this year, the agriculture ministry said.
